system.description:
As a Reaction, you may spend one Superiority die when you would make a saving throw of any type, your clones become aware and dispel themselves to invigorate you with resolve. Dismiss any number of clones or Bunshin. You gain a +1 bonus to your saving throw equal to the number of dismissed clones or Bunshin (Max +4).

| #### Design Note(s) / Clone Scout / The Clone Scout subclass that you see before you is built currently in a semi-final state. This is primarily due to its original connection to the Clone Keyword and the various Clone based Jutsu and feats. / Clones currently have a list of rules as long as a CVS receipt (If you don’t get this reference/Joke, then instead see the following Link ) / I am hoping to simplify clones to a more understandable level that doesn’t require a Law degree in Naruto. See below for a potential updated text for the Clone Keyword. While the Clone scout no longer lives and dies by the keywords text, this will also simplify it for normal clone users. / Clone. Ninjutsu with this keyword creates creatures which are duplicates/clones of the caster and are controlled by the caster. When summoned they resemble the casters physical and visual attributes and creatures cannot discern the difference between a clone and its caster unless they take the Search Action vs the casters Stealth DC or have Chakra Sight. Clones do not have any items, weapons or armor. Clones can only act as a Bonus action their casters turn. All clones have the same following statistics/limitations unless otherwise specified; / Resources: / Clones have 1 hit point, can be commanded to take 1 Action, and have a 30-foot movement speed. / Can cast 1 jutsu from your known list, that does not have the Fuinjutsu, Combination or Clone keywords, before being dispelled. / Cannot maintain concentration on Jutsu. / If a Clone is summoned out of Combat and its duration is less than 10 minutes, its duration becomes 10 minutes. / Combat: / AC equal to your Ninjutsu save DC and uses your attack bonuses and Save DCs. / Clones can only ever make a single attack per command, regardless of the number of attacks the jutsu allows. / Weapon/Unarmed attacks made by clones, deal 1d6 damage. / Jutsu cast by clones that deal damage, deals 2d6 damage, unless the jutsu cast deals less damage. / Clones cannot force a creature to make more than 1 saving throw per round. / Restrictions: / Cannot use your Class or Clan features. / Has no proficiencies, ability scores or statistics of its own. / Cannot benefit from any bonus to its statistics. / Casting a jutsu with this keyword while Clones are already active from the same jutsu, dismisses all active Clones of that jutsu |
